name: Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students
des: The Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students is a Maharashtra Government scheme implemented through the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) and MahaDBT portal for students belonging to the Economically Backward Class (EBC) category. The scheme provides reimbursement of 50% of Tuition Fee and 50% of Development Fee to eligible students pursuing professional and technical courses including MBA, MMS, MCA, Engineering, Pharmacy, Architecture, Hotel Management, and other AICTE-approved programs. The objective of the scheme is to reduce the financial burden on economically weaker students from the Open category and enable them to continue higher education. Family income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 per annum. Benefits are disbursed through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account after institute and department verification. MBA students admitted through MAH-MBA CET CAP rounds are eligible under this scheme.
benefits: Applicable to MBA, MMS, MCA, Engineering, Pharmacy, Architecture, Hotel Management and other professional courses
Benefit is calculated on fees approved by the Fee Regulating Authority (FRA)
Available for students studying in Government, Government-Aided and eligible Private Unaided institutions
Scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student's Aadhaar-linked bank account through DBT
Benefit is available throughout the duration of the course subject to annual renewal
Students can continue receiving benefits in subsequent years after passing and renewing the application
No separate maintenance allowance is provided under this scheme
No hostel allowance is provided under this scheme
Maximum benefit is limited to 50% of Tuition Fee and 50% of Development Fee approved by the competent authority
MBA students admitted through CAP are eligible under the professional course category
criteria: Applicant must be a domicile of Maharashtra
Applicant must belong to the Economically Backward Class (EBC) category
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹8,00,000
Student must be admitted through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP)
MBA admission should be through MAH-MBA CET CAP rounds
Management Quota admissions are not eligible
Institute-level admissions are generally not eligible unless covered under government guidelines
Applicant must be studying in a recognized institution approved by the Government of Maharashtra
Student must not be receiving any other fee reimbursement scholarship for the same educational purpose
Applicant must possess an Aadhaar-linked bank account
Student must maintain satisfactory academic progress for renewal
Student must remain enrolled in the approved course for which scholarship is sanctioned
required_documents: Income Certificate issued by competent authority (family income ≤ ₹8,00,000)
EBC Certificate / Self Declaration as prescribed
Fee Structure approved by FRA/Competent Authority
application_process: Click 'New Applicant Registration' and register using Aadhaar-linked mobile number
Login and complete Applicant Profile with personal, academic and bank account details
Navigate to Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) schemes section
Select 'Dr. Ambedkar Post-Matric Scholarship for EBC Students'
Select MBA course and enter institute details
Enter CAP allotment details and admission information accurately
Upload all required documents in JPG/PDF format
Verify fee details and personal information carefully
Note the Application ID for future reference
Track application status through MahaDBT Granular Application Tracking
Ensure institute verification is completed before the application deadline
Renew the application every academic year to continue receiving benefits
